mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions with a temperature of 70 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection for that Thursday will be pushed to Friday, November 27.
We have a great lineup ahead including live music at Bailey's Run today, live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a recent report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's delicious flavor is OREO Cookie Overload, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your sweet tooth.
